all.name: OPENSSL_THREADS
all.role: Enables thread-safe global state and per-context locks; enabled by default on supported threaded targets per INSTALL.md.

all.name: OPENSSL_PIC
all.role: Builds position-independent objects for shared libraries; selected by the default shared build per Configure.

all.name: OPENSSL_NO_DEPRECATED
all.role: Removes deprecated APIs through the current configured API level; selected by the no-deprecated option documented in INSTALL.md.

all.name: OPENSSL_NO_ASM
all.role: Disables assembly implementations; no-asm is documented in INSTALL.md as a debugging and portability option.
